name: psr/log
remediation_notes: PSR-3 is stable standard infrastructure. Dormancy is expected for mature interface specs; lack of commits doesn't indicate rot. Keep using it across your ecosystem.

name: doctrine/lexer
remediation_notes: A 155-line lexer utility with no dependencies—small enough to copy directly into consuming projects. Last release was 813 days ago; the code is stable but no longer maintained.

name: psr/container
remediation_notes: PSR-11 is the PHP Framework Interop Group standard for dependency injection container interfaces. The lack of updates is expected for a stable contract that 502k repos depend on; pin the version and treat this as foundational infrastructure.

name: sebastian/resource-operations
remediation_notes: Dead 775 days. Tiny reference library (2.2K LOC) listing PHP resource functions—inlineable since the list is stable. The 489k dependents are inflated through transitive bundling; actual consumers are PHPUnit and Drupal distribution packages.

name: phpdocumentor/reflection-common
remediation_notes: Only 98 lines with zero dependencies—copy it into the consuming project. Drupal's locked dependency set (93% of usage) won't update anyway.

name: phar-io/version
remediation_notes: Almost all usage flows through phar-io/manifest (770M downloads). Switching to composer/semver—Composer's official semantic versioning package—would address the entire ecosystem. Library is stable but 4+ years unmaintained; active maintenance elsewhere reduces long-term risk.

name: phar-io/manifest
remediation_notes: Stable library for a focused task (phar.io manifest reading) with no maintained alternative. Drupal controls most usage via webflo/drupal-core-strict. Pin the version and audit the code if needed, but dormant status poses minimal risk for stable, complete software.

name: swiftmailer/swiftmailer
remediation_notes: SwiftMailer reached end-of-life in November 2021 and has been archived. Symfony Mailer is the official successor with the same feature set and active maintenance; migrate off SwiftMailer to it.

name: egulias/email-validator
remediation_notes: Email validation rules are stable; this library is feature-complete and was passing tests 418 days ago. Pin to v4.x, monitor for CVEs, but inactivity is acceptable for a solved domain.

name: psr/simple-cache
remediation_notes: PSR-16 is a stable specification interface; the absence of updates is expected and safe. Dependents should keep using it unchanged.

name: symfony/polyfill-php72
remediation_notes: PHP 7.2 polyfill with stable, minimal code (66 LOC). Top dependent (symfony/polyfill-xml) accounts for 70% of usage. Pin the version and carry the risk—there's no maintained alternative and no reason this code would break.

name: symfony/polyfill-intl-idn
remediation_notes: Stable polyfill for standardized Intl functions; swiftmailer's dominance makes it essential. Pin the version and retire when dropping support for PHP versions below 7.2.

name: symfony/event-dispatcher-contracts
remediation_notes: This package provides stable, battle-tested contracts for the Symfony event ecosystem. While dormant, it's unlikely to need updates since interface stability is the point; the dependency chain stays healthy through actively-maintained packages like symfony/security and Shopware.

name: phpunit/php-token-stream
remediation_notes: Stable archived code with huge transitive spread through dev tools. Pin and accept the risk; only direct dependents should consider forking for ongoing maintenance.

name: psr/http-message
remediation_notes: PSR-7 is the industry standard for HTTP messages in PHP. The lack of recent commits reflects specification stability, not abandonment. Pin the current version—there are no security vectors in interface definitions, and breaking away creates ecosystem incompatibility.

name: symfony/polyfill-php73
remediation_notes: Polyfill for stable PHP 7.3 functions, unchanged for 19 months because the implementation is complete. At 104 LOC with zero dependencies, dependents should vendor this code directly rather than maintain an external dependency on stable, feature-complete functions.

name: fzaninotto/faker
remediation_notes: Faker is explicitly archived; the author published a sunsetting post. Migrate to fakerphp/faker, a community-maintained fork with API compatibility that's become the PHP ecosystem standard replacement.

name: symfony/debug
remediation_notes: Symfony deprecated this component in 4.4 and officially recommends ErrorHandler as the replacement. Dependents should migrate to ErrorHandler, which is actively maintained and provides equivalent functionality.

name: paragonie/random_compat
remediation_notes: Dormant since 2021 with an unresolved security advisory. At 521 LOC, inlining is practical and safer than pinning unmaintained code. For PHP 7.1+, migrate directly to built-in `random_bytes()` and `random_int()`.

name: ralouphie/getallheaders
remediation_notes: Trivial 34-line polyfill for native PHP `getallheaders()`. Safe to vendor directly since no maintenance is required and the code won't change. Removes supply chain exposure.

name: dnoegel/php-xdg-base-dir
remediation_notes: At 79 lines with no dependencies, this stable XDG implementation is simpler to vendor than to maintain as a dependency. Copy the code directly into your project.

name: fideloper/proxy
remediation_notes: Merged into Laravel 5.5+ and built-in through 8.x. For Laravel 9+, remove the dependency and use the built-in trusted proxy configuration. For older versions, this is stable and the official solution.

name: symfony/polyfill-intl-normalizer
remediation_notes: Stable polyfill for PHP's Normalizer class; dormancy is normal for completed polyfill code. Pin the version.

name: symfony/deprecation-contracts
remediation_notes: With only 103 lines of code and a single exported function, projects can eliminate this dependency by copying trigger_deprecation() directly into their codebase. The dormant maintenance status makes inlining especially attractive.

name: psr/event-dispatcher
remediation_notes: This is a specification-only package with 21 lines of code. Dependents should vendor the interfaces directly to eliminate the unmaintained dependency with no functional impact.

name: facade/ignition-contracts
remediation_notes: Pin the version. Stable interface package (96 LOC, zero transitive deps) for the Flare error-handling ecosystem. Dominant dependents (facade/ignition, facade/flare-client-php) remain maintained and handle compatibility implicitly.

name: jakub-onderka/php-console-highlighter
remediation_notes: The original author maintains a successor package under php-parallel-lint. Switch to pkg:composer/php-parallel-lint/php-console-highlighter, which is actively maintained as the drop-in replacement.

name: jakub-onderka/php-console-color
remediation_notes: The maintainer explicitly directs users to php-parallel-lint's fork, which is actively maintained. The 194-line codebase is trivial to adopt, but switching avoids carrying an unmaintained package when a working alternative is readily available.

name: facade/ignition
remediation_notes: The original maintainers have officially endorsed spatie/laravel-ignition as a drop-in replacement for Laravel 8+. Their README recommends switching and states only security fixes will be added to facade/ignition going forward.

name: facade/flare-client-php
remediation_notes: Legacy client for PHP < 8.0 and Laravel < 9. Switch to spatie/flare-client-php for modern versions. Projects on older versions should pin and plan framework upgrades.

name: sebastian/code-unit
remediation_notes: Package is only 609 LOC with zero runtime dependencies and narrow scope (PHP code unit value objects). trebol/entrust (90% of downloads) and other dependents should vendor the code rather than depend on unmaintained code.

name: psr/http-client
remediation_notes: PSR-18 defines the PHP HTTP client interface standard. Dormancy for 2.6 years is normal for a settled specification; no implementation changes needed.

name: league/mime-type-detection
remediation_notes: Small, well-tested utility nearly exclusively used by Flysystem adapters. Code simplicity and maturity make pinning viable; consider symfony/mime for active maintenance but requires API changes.

name: psr/http-factory
remediation_notes: PSR-17 is a completed interface specification, not active software. The 171k dependents are distributed via maintained wrappers. Pin the version and accept it; no standard replacement exists.

name: fakerphp/faker
remediation_notes: Testing library with 158k dependents, mostly small projects. Dormant but not abandoned (commit 83d ago). Pinning at a stable version is safe; monitor for security issues but don't rush to replace.

name: phpunit/phpunit-mock-objects
remediation_notes: PHPUnit absorbed mock functionality into the core library starting with v5.4. Dependents should upgrade PHPUnit and migrate to the built-in mocking API.

name: fruitcake/laravel-cors
remediation_notes: Package is explicitly deprecated; Laravel 9+ includes CORS middleware natively. Dependents should replace the package with built-in \Illuminate\Http\Middleware\HandleCors and remove from composer.json. Older Laravel versions should upgrade or pin the package.

name: doctrine/cache
remediation_notes: The maintainers explicitly deprecated this in favor of PSR-6/PSR-16 standards. Symfony Cache is the most widely adopted actively-maintained replacement.

name: doctrine/annotations
remediation_notes: Feature-complete library in maintenance mode across 2,552 distributed dependents. PHP 8 attributes offer a future path but require code rewrites. Pin the version and accept the risk—the codebase is stable and maintained for security.

name: symfony/polyfill-php81
remediation_notes: 137 lines of stable polyfill functions for PHP 8.1 features. Dormant since 596 days, but 125K downstream repos with no reported issues indicate it's effectively complete. Copy the code directly or accept and pin for transitive dependents.

name: dflydev/dot-access-data
remediation_notes: 91% of usage flows through league/config, which actively maintains this transitive dependency. The simple, dependency-free codebase can be safely pinned for direct users.

name: doctrine/common
remediation_notes: Explicitly deprecated in favor of composer/package-versions-deprecated. Dormant but stable; dependents should migrate to the maintained successor, though there's no immediate risk.

name: league/config
remediation_notes: This 261-LOC configuration validator is dormant but stable; the primary dependent (moxio/commonmark-ext-fancy-lists, 155k downloads) should inline the code to eliminate the dependency.

name: psr/cache
remediation_notes: psr/cache is a PSR-6 specification package—dormancy is not a risk since specs don't require ongoing maintenance. All real implementations (Doctrine, League, etc.) are actively maintained; pin the version and treat as stable infrastructure.

name: symfony/polyfill-uuid
remediation_notes: This polyfill is small (594 LOC), has zero dependencies, and is self-contained, making it safe to vendor into consuming projects. Modern PHP includes native UUID support; projects supporting PHP 7.4+ should migrate to ext-uuid instead.

name: symfony/polyfill-php56
remediation_notes: With 57 lines and zero dependencies, vendors can safely copy the three polyfill functions directly into their codebase rather than depend on this 2013-era unmaintained package. PHP 5.6 reached EOL in 2017.

name: symfony/polyfill-php70
remediation_notes: Polyfill for PHP 7.0 features, unmaintained for ~5.5 years. Modern PHP 7.0+ includes all features natively; dependents should upgrade their minimum PHP version and remove this dependency.

name: beyondcode/laravel-dump-server
remediation_notes: Extraordinarily stable debug utility—only 3 total commits and 144 LOC. Dormancy is appropriate for a feature-complete dev-only tool. Pin the version, and carry minimal risk.

name: laravelcollective/html
remediation_notes: The package explicitly recommends migrating to spatie/laravel-html. For 48k+ dependent repos, a wholesale switch to this maintained fork avoids the coordination problem of adopting an unmaintained package.

name: composer/installers
remediation_notes: Stable installer plugin for 45K+ repos. Composer 2.1's getInstalledPackagesByType() isn't a replacement—it discovers packages, not install paths. Existing projects need this for WordPress, Drupal, etc. Pin the version.

name: sensio/framework-extra-bundle
remediation_notes: Archived and explicitly deprecated in its README. Symfony 6.2+ includes native attribute support for controller configuration as the official replacement; upgrade Symfony and migrate annotations to native PHP attributes.

name: composer/xdebug-handler
remediation_notes: phpmd accounts for 97.5% of usage. The library is stable and small (645 LOC)—major consumers should vendor the code rather than carry this dormant dependency.

name: phpspec/php-diff
remediation_notes: Unmaintained for 5+ years but just 957 LOC with zero dependencies. The dominant dependent (wyndow/fuzzywuzzy at 90% of usage) or other consumers can readily inline the diff logic into their own codebase.

name: mtdowling/cron-expression
remediation_notes: Officially deprecated since 2017 with development moved to dragonmantank/cron-expression. Switch directly—the fork is a drop-in replacement.

name: zendframework/zend-diactoros
remediation_notes: The repository was abandoned in 2019 and officially transferred to Laminas. laminas-diactoros is the maintained drop-in replacement and resolves the 3 known advisories.

name: seld/jsonlint
remediation_notes: Dead for 2 years with 37K dependent repos split across many projects—no steward. The 713-line, dependency-free validator is easily vendored; projects needing advanced features (duplicate keys, comments, better errors) can copy it in, others can use PHP's built-in json_decode.

name: zendframework/zend-eventmanager
remediation_notes: Officially abandoned 2019-12-31 with explicit migration to actively maintained laminas/laminas-eventmanager; drop-in replacement available.

name: jdorn/sql-formatter
remediation_notes: 679 LOC, single file, zero dependencies—trivial to copy into the consuming project. Shopware core/platform account for 66.5% of usage and would each benefit from vendoring locally rather than relying on an unmaintained dependency.

name: seld/phar-utils
remediation_notes: Kint debugger drives 61% of usage. The 182-line PHP utility is small enough to copy into projects, making vendoring the safest path for dependents.

name: symfony/swiftmailer-bundle
remediation_notes: Symfony deprecated this bundle in favor of Symfony Mailer, which provides equivalent features with modern PHP support. Migrate rather than maintain a dead dependency.

name: laminas/laminas-zendframework-bridge
remediation_notes: Laminas TSC maintains this intentionally in security-only mode. The 503-line bridge is stable and serves its specific migration purpose. Accept the dependency; most projects inherit it through Laminas packages anyway.

name: namshi/jose
remediation_notes: The package maintainers have deprecated namshi/jose and explicitly recommend switching to firebase/php-jwt, which is actively maintained and provides drop-in replacement functionality for JWS/JWT signing and verification.

name: psr/link
remediation_notes: This package only defines PSR-13 interfaces (37 lines across 4 files). Copy them into your codebase to drop the unmaintained dependency—PSR standards are stable and interfaces don't rot.

name: symfony/class-loader
remediation_notes: Complete, stable autoloading from the Symfony 2 era; modern PHP uses native PSR-4 support. For legacy projects still depending on it, pin the version and plan a broader modernization.

name: php-http/httplug
remediation_notes: Stable HTTP client abstraction (174 LOC) with 582-day commit silence. Pin the version; PSR-18 is the direction but requires API changes and doesn't cover async use cases that some dependents rely on.

name: container-interop/container-interop
remediation_notes: Officially deprecated since Feb 2017 in favor of PSR-11; migrate to psr/container for standards compliance. The package remains stable but receives no updates.

name: php-http/message-factory
remediation_notes: The package's own README declares it obsolete; PSR-17 is the maintained standard that HTTP client libraries already implement.

name: zendframework/zend-stdlib
remediation_notes: Zend Framework was discontinued in favor of Laminas. The README redirects to laminas/laminas-stdlib, the maintained successor. Most dependents are internal to the Zend ecosystem and can migrate together with their own upstream transitions.

name: zendframework/zend-code
remediation_notes: Switch to the actively maintained Laminas fork, laminas/laminas-code. Projects using other Zend packages may need parallel migration since much of the Zend ecosystem was archived alongside this one.

name: myclabs/php-enum
remediation_notes: The package explicitly recommends migrating to PHP 8.1+ native enums. Projects meeting that requirement should switch directly; those stuck on older PHP should pin the version, evaluate their PHP upgrade timeline, or vendor the small 142-line codebase if needed.

name: classpreloader/classpreloader
remediation_notes: Dormant PHP class preloader with 86% usage concentrated in flipbox/lumen-generator. Small, stable codebase with no maintained alternative; pinning a version is reasonable for this performance-optimization tool.

name: symfony/security-guard
remediation_notes: Spryker/Silex dominates (94%); Silex is itself unmaintained. Others should migrate to Symfony Passport (5.4+), replacing Guard's approach. Pinning is viable for stable code, but migration is the long-term path.

name: defuse/php-encryption
remediation_notes: Dormant but stable: this encryption library provides a carefully designed, difficult-to-misuse OpenSSL API. Most dependents should pin v2.4.0 and accept the maintenance risk—there is no drop-in replacement, and PHP's built-in crypto functions require code rewrites.

name: league/event
remediation_notes: Switch to Symfony EventDispatcher, an actively maintained PSR-14 implementation that provides drop-in compatibility with minimal code changes.

name: composer/package-versions-deprecated
remediation_notes: Package is EOL and explicitly deprecated; migrate to Composer\InstalledVersions built into Composer 2.x. Each dependent needs to update code and drop the dependency.

name: doctrine/reflection
remediation_notes: Doctrine officially abandoned this package; roave/better-reflection is the recommended replacement. Doctrine-specific features moved to doctrine/persistence. At 19k dependent repos, migration is spread but the path is clear.

name: sensio/distribution-bundle
remediation_notes: This bundle is archived and incompatible with Symfony 4+. Pin the version for legacy Symfony 2-3 projects—it will continue to work. Active projects should upgrade to Symfony 4+, which replaces its functionality through Flex recipes and modern tooling.

name: sensio/generator-bundle
remediation_notes: Archived code generator for Symfony; the official Symfony Maker bundle is the maintained replacement. Dependents should migrate their code generation to Maker rather than maintain this package.

name: markbaker/complex
remediation_notes: Complex number operations are mathematically stable and carry no external dependencies; one of the large dependents—particularly PHPSpreadsheet—should fork maintenance rather than 18K+ repos depending on an unmaintained package.

name: guzzle/guzzle
remediation_notes: Guzzle 3 is archived and explicitly deprecated in favor of guzzlehttp/guzzle, the official successor. Migrate to guzzlehttp/guzzle for active maintenance.

name: php-http/promise
remediation_notes: Explicitly deprecated in favor of an upcoming Promise PSR. At 75 LOC, inlining is trivial; geocoder-php/plugin (94% of usage) should adopt the implementation directly.

name: markbaker/matrix
remediation_notes: Stable matrix math library dormant for 3+ years, no known bugs. Dominated by PHPSpreadsheet usage (49%+). No maintained alternative exists; pin the version.

name: ocramius/proxy-manager
remediation_notes: Broadly distributed across frameworks with no apparent maintained replacement. Code is stable and low-risk; dependents should pin versions and plan migration as needed.

name: mikey179/vfsstream
remediation_notes: Stable testing utility with zero runtime dependencies; no updates needed when the underlying platform is stable. With 17.8k dependents, switching isn't practical—pin the version and monitor for PHP compatibility issues.

name: nyholm/psr7
remediation_notes: PSR-7 is a stable specification unlikely to require updates. Pin the version, monitor the single advisory. Migrating across 1,753 dependents would fragment the ecosystem and increase long-term risk.

name: doctrine/doctrine-cache-bundle
remediation_notes: The bundle is archived in favor of symfony/cache, Symfony's native caching component. Dependents should migrate to symfony/cache for Symfony caching needs; doctrine/cache can be configured manually if specifically required.

name: kylekatarnls/update-helper
remediation_notes: 93% of usage is in api-skeletons/laravel-hal. Code is small and self-contained; vendoring eliminates the unmaintained dependency. Pinning the version is also viable if the feature isn't actively used.

name: twig/extensions
remediation_notes: Migrate to maintained replacements per extension: symfony/twig-bridge for translation, twig/intl for localization, twig/extra for text filters. The shuffle and time_diff filters are unmaintained; implement locally if needed.

name: symfony/inflector
remediation_notes: Dominated by Shopware (79.9% of usage). Switch to symfony/string's EnglishInflector, the officially-recommended maintained replacement since Symfony 5.1.

name: mtdowling/jmespath.php
remediation_notes: Alibaba Cloud SDK dominates usage (44%, 3.6M downloads). The library is small enough (2,077 LOC, 12 files) for dependent maintainers to copy if they need to move off this dormant package.

name: php-http/guzzle6-adapter
remediation_notes: This adapter wraps Guzzle 6 to provide PSR-18 support. Guzzle 7+ implements PSR-18 natively, so upgrade to Guzzle 7 and remove the adapter dependency.

name: jms/parser-lib
remediation_notes: Dormant for 4+ years with only 187 lines of code. Vendor into dependents—the size makes inlining trivial, and it decouples from an unmaintained dependency.

name: nikic/fast-route
remediation_notes: FastRoute is dormant but stable with zero runtime dependencies. Symfony Routing is actively maintained with similar routing capabilities and is the standard replacement for new projects.

name: psr/clock
remediation_notes: PSR-20 standard interface for PHP clocks. Dormancy is normal for a frozen standard. Keep as a dependency; consumers will choose implementations like stella-maris/clock or beste/clock based on their needs.

name: ircmaxell/password-compat
remediation_notes: Drop this dependency unless you're on PHP 5.3–5.4. Modern projects use native password_hash(). For legacy projects that must stay on old PHP, the 205-line polyfill is simple enough to vendor directly.

name: phpcollection/phpcollection
remediation_notes: 97.6% of usage is via jms packages; the 1,083-line codebase is stable and small enough for the JMS maintainers to inline into their core packages (jms/di-extra-bundle and jms/serializer).

name: symfony/assetic-bundle
remediation_notes: AsseticBundle is archived. Symfony 4.0+ recommends Webpack Encore; migrate to webpack-encore-bundle if you can upgrade. For Symfony 3.4 projects, pin the version and manage the risk locally.

name: phpmd/phpmd
remediation_notes: No releases in 869 days, zero active maintainers. Migrate to PHPStan, an actively maintained static analyzer that covers PHPMD's linting use cases.

name: kriswallsmith/assetic
remediation_notes: The original maintainer explicitly moved development to assetic/framework (assetic-php/assetic). Direct users to that maintained fork.

name: sensiolabs/security-checker
remediation_notes: The package is archived and explicitly deprecated in its README, which warns the web service stopped in January 2021 and recommends switching to local-php-security-checker instead.

name: league/oauth1-client
remediation_notes: OAuth 1.0 (RFC 5849) is a stable, complete standard. The package is dormant by design, not neglect. Pin versions and monitor for security; maintenance isn't needed for protocol compliance.

name: zendframework/zend-escaper
remediation_notes: This package was abandoned in 2019 in favor of laminas/laminas-escaper, its official successor. Switch to the maintained Laminas alternative, which is API-compatible.

name: php-cs-fixer/diff
remediation_notes: Archived fork of sebastian/diff created for older PHP compatibility. Migrate to the actively maintained original library by Sebastian Bergmann, which handles the backward compatibility now.

name: symfony/polyfill-apcu
remediation_notes: Stable polyfill for unchanging APCu protocol. Dormancy is appropriate; pin version and verify APCu compatibility in your PHP matrix.

name: fabpot/goutte
remediation_notes: Goutte is explicitly deprecated by its maintainer in favor of Symfony's HttpBrowser component, which is actively maintained. Migrate by replacing Goutte\Client with Symfony\Component\BrowserKit\HttpBrowser.

name: behat/transliterator
remediation_notes: Maintainers explicitly recommend switching to Symfony String, PHP's native Transliterator (ext-intl), or iconv. Package is abandoned due to licensing issues and unmaintained transliteration data (unchanged since 2016).

name: fig/link-util
remediation_notes: Unmaintained for five years, but the 265-line PSR-13 utilities are small enough to vendor directly into consuming projects — particularly important since the dominant dependent (Silex) is itself unmaintained.

name: michelf/php-markdown
remediation_notes: Stable, mature library with zero dependencies. Dependents should pin the version, monitor PHP compatibility, and plan eventual migration to league/commonmark if active maintenance becomes necessary.

name: codeception/phpunit-wrapper
remediation_notes: A stable PHPUnit wrapper for codeception/base; small enough (3K lines) to copy into consuming projects and eliminate the archived-package dependency.

name: composer/pcre
remediation_notes: 99.3% of usage in composer/xdebug-handler (411M+ downloads). Composer org should adopt and maintain this critical utility, or vendor its 875 LOC directly into xdebug-handler.

name: behat/mink-selenium2-driver
remediation_notes: Dormant but stable. Handles WebDriver protocol for 831 packages (9,674 repos). No clear replacement exists. Dependents should pin versions; alternatives like Playwright require test rewrites.

name: php-http/discovery
remediation_notes: Dormant PSR-18/PSR-17 discovery utility with 9400+ dependent repos. No single consumer can realistically take over; discovery logic is stable and doesn't require active maintenance. Dependents should pin the version and accept the unmaintained-but-functional state.

name: behat/mink-goutte-driver
remediation_notes: Archived and explicitly deprecated in favor of behat/mink-browserkit-driver. Migrate to the official replacement driver, which provides identical Mink integration.

name: webmozart/path-util
remediation_notes: Package is deprecated and merged into Symfony Filesystem Component 5.4+. Migrate to symfony/filesystem for the same path utilities with active maintenance.

name: willdurand/negotiation
remediation_notes: RFC 7231 implementation is mature with zero runtime dependencies; safe to pin. Broad ecosystem adoption rules out single-steward adoption path.

name: stack/builder
remediation_notes: Drupal Core accounts for 89% of usage and treats it as a stable lock. The middleware builder is trivial to inline—copy the 77 lines into your project rather than maintain a dependency on abandoned code.

name: pusher/pusher-php-server
remediation_notes: Official Pusher client library that's feature-complete but dormant; pin the version and monitor for security updates. Heavy users may consider vendoring or forking if Pusher deprioritizes the 1 known advisory.

name: jenssegers/agent
remediation_notes: Stable wrapper with zero churn for 5+ years. Runtime dependencies remain maintained. Pin the version; vendoring is an option for applications where unmaintained transitive dependencies are a concern.

name: facebook/webdriver
remediation_notes: This package is archived; its maintainers explicitly recommend php-webdriver/php-webdriver as a maintained replacement for Selenium WebDriver bindings in PHP.

name: zendframework/zend-validator
remediation_notes: Repository abandoned 2019; active maintenance continued at Laminas. Most dependents are other Zendframework packages—updating requires coordinating migrations across the Zend component stack, or vendoring validators for legacy projects.

name: sebastian/phpcpd
remediation_notes: Mature tool with stable heuristics; development-only, small codebase. Pin and accept the risk.

name: pdepend/pdepend
remediation_notes: Dormant development-time analysis tool with broad, distributed reach. Pinning the version mitigates risk; no single replacement covers its full feature set. Migration is feasible for large teams, but coordination across 7,000+ dependents is not practical.

name: psr/http-server-middleware
remediation_notes: This is a PSR-15 standard interface specification that reached maturity and requires no active maintenance. The interface is stable, carries no security risk, and the large dependent ecosystem (league/openapi-psr7-validator, zendframework/zend-stratigility) is actively maintained.

name: phpoffice/phpexcel
remediation_notes: PHPExcel is permanently archived with no maintenance since 2015. The official successor, PhpSpreadsheet, is actively maintained by the same organization and offers a direct migration path for the 7,000+ dependent repositories.

name: php-parallel-lint/php-parallel-lint
remediation_notes: Parallel PHP syntax checker with no maintained alternative. Dependents should vendor the ~1.9k LOC or move parallelization to CI-level (GitHub Actions matrix, etc.) with native `php -l` checks.

name: php-http/message
remediation_notes: No single maintained replacement. Swap PSR-7 messages to guzzlehttp/psr7 or laminas-diactoros; reimplement other utilities (decorators, matchers, encoding) as needed. Monitor the 1 dead transitive dependency.

name: guzzlehttp/streams
remediation_notes: Ringphp and other Guzzle 4-5 packages account for 98.8% of usage and depend on this for legacy stream handling. Migrate to Guzzle 6+, which has native PSR-7 stream support.

name: league/fractal
remediation_notes: Dormant but stable with widespread usage (6,650 repos). No single replacement covers all transformation use cases—pin to a recent version and monitor, or fork if the project needs to move off Composer-based distribution.

name: evenement/evenement
remediation_notes: Minimal event dispatcher (134 LOC, no dependencies) heavily used by ReactPHP ecosystem through high-volume packages. Stable API rarely needs updates; dormancy is acceptable for this category of code.

name: clue/stream-filter
remediation_notes: ReactPHP ecosystem accounts for 97% of dependents; dormant but stable with no runtime dependencies. Pin the version and move on.

name: behat/mink-extension
remediation_notes: Package is archived and officially recommends switching to friends-of-behat/mink-extension, which is maintained and a direct drop-in replacement.

name: amphp/byte-stream
remediation_notes: Dormant but stable; 71% of usage is amphp/process and the amphp ecosystem, which still ships. Pin the version unless amphp itself stalls.

name: composer/metadata-minifier
remediation_notes: Inline the 53 lines into the 10 direct dependents. Protocol-specific code with no alternatives and proven stability—1 commit ever, 5-year-old release, zero maintenance needed.

name: fig/http-message-util
remediation_notes: Only 83 lines of PHP constants and utilities with no dependencies. Most usage is through Zend Framework packages, which should vendor this themselves; direct users can copy the code into their projects.

name: psr/http-server-handler
remediation_notes: This is a stable PSR-15 interface specification in the PHP ecosystem. Dormancy is expected for standardized definitions; the 8-line interface doesn't need active maintenance and is safe to pin.

name: pear/pear_exception
remediation_notes: Copy the single exception class (308 lines, no dependencies) into your project and drop the dependency. This is a legacy PEAR package that hasn't been meaningfully updated in years.

name: react/stream
remediation_notes: Stable ReactPHP streams library with dormant maintenance and no dead transitive dependencies. Pin the version; no urgent action needed unless major dependents seek to guarantee future updates.

name: guzzlehttp/ringphp
remediation_notes: RingPHP abstracted HTTP handling for Guzzle 5; modern versions of Guzzle (7+) and PHP's PSR-18 standard make this layer unnecessary.

name: willdurand/jsonp-callback-validator
remediation_notes: The validator is 67 lines with zero dependencies—small enough to vendor directly into projects. Dependents should copy it rather than maintain the external dependency; teams doing new work should migrate away from JSONP.

name: jeremeamia/superclosure
remediation_notes: The author explicitly recommends opis/closure as the maintained successor. With 5002 dependent repos across 325 packages, a coordinated ecosystem migration to that drop-in replacement is more practical than forking or vendoring unmaintained serialization code.

name: nette/finder
remediation_notes: Nette consolidated this package into nette/utils (its successor). Migrate to nette/utils where file finder functionality is actively maintained and developed.

name: pear/console_getopt
remediation_notes: Drupal's locked dependencies package accounts for 98.2% of usage. The code is stable utility (593 LOC, zero dependencies); dependents can stay pinned or migrate to Console_CommandLine, which the package itself recommends.

name: beberlei/assert
remediation_notes: Dormant since February 2025; small, stable codebase but zero active maintainers. webmozart/assert provides equivalent input validation assertions with ongoing maintenance. Straightforward migration for consuming libraries.

name: knplabs/knp-components
remediation_notes: One dependent (sphinx-bundle) accounts for two-thirds of usage. Its maintainers should fork and own knp-components rather than depend on dormant code.

name: react/cache
remediation_notes: This is a minimal (114 LOC) async cache interface that ReactPHP uses internally; 97% of dependents are ReactPHP itself and its ecosystem. ReactPHP remains active. Dormancy is normal for a stable interface.

name: aws/aws-crt-php
remediation_notes: Top dependents are forks of the AWS SDK for PHP. Migrate to the official, actively maintained aws/aws-sdk-php, which handles CRT integration as an implementation detail.

name: felixfbecker/advanced-json-rpc
remediation_notes: Small, stable protocol handler with zero transitive dependencies. Inline it into language-server and other consumers rather than maintaining the unmaintained transitive dependency.

name: grasmash/expander
remediation_notes: Expander is well-tested (full CI/coverage) and dormant rather than broken, making it safe to vendor. The code solves a specific niche—dot-notation expansion in config—with no obvious maintained alternative, but its small surface area makes that irrelevant.

name: openlss/lib-array2xml
remediation_notes: Only 180 PHP lines with no runtime dependencies. Copying the code directly into your project is simpler and safer than maintaining a 7-year-old unmaintained dependency.

name: felixfbecker/language-server-protocol
remediation_notes: The top dependent (felixfbecker/language-server) is itself unmaintained and accounts for nearly all usage. Since this package is small, dependency-free, and protocol-definition-only, vendoring is more practical than seeking a maintained alternative.

name: webflo/drupal-finder
remediation_notes: Drupal's core tooling (Console, Drush, phpstan-drupal) concentrates 82% of usage in a single dependent. This essential infrastructure code should be adopted by the Drupal project or formally maintained by one of the major dependents rather than left unmaintained.

name: theseer/fdomdocument
remediation_notes: Small archived DOM wrapper. Largest dependent (sebastian/finder-facade, 41M downloads) can fork and maintain. Others should migrate to PHP's built-in DOM with exception handling via try-catch—the wrapper's functionality is straightforward to replicate.

name: sebastian/finder-facade
remediation_notes: 117-line wrapper around Symfony/Finder. 95% of usage is sebastian/phpdcd, which is also abandoned. Dependents should vendor the wrapper code directly; phpdcd users should fork or drop the tool.

name: true/punycode
remediation_notes: Replace with PHP's built-in idn_to_ascii() and idn_to_utf8() functions (intl extension), which the package's own README recommends. For projects that need pure PHP with no native dependencies, the package is small enough to vendor (~250 lines) if intl isn't available.

name: stella-maris/clock
remediation_notes: Copy the clock-interface definition (18 PHP lines) into your project. When PSR-20 is officially published, switch to that standard instead.

name: symfony/polyfill-php55
remediation_notes: Unmaintained since 2013 but stable—60 lines of PHP 5.5 backports with no dependencies. Copy the functions you need or upgrade to modern PHP.

name: symfony/polyfill-php54
remediation_notes: Abandoned in 2013. At 59 lines with three simple polyfill functions, inline them directly rather than maintaining the dependency. PHP 5.4 reached EOL in 2014 anyway.

name: google/crc32
remediation_notes: PHP 8.0+ provides native hardware-accelerated CRC32 via the hash framework. Update code to use hash() functions and require PHP 8.0+ if possible.

name: sentry/sdk
remediation_notes: This meta package is dormant; the maintainers recommend using sentry/sentry directly. sentry/sentry is actively maintained and is the official PHP SDK.

name: hashids/hashids
remediation_notes: The original creator released Sqids as an actively maintained successor. Hashids remains stable but dormant; projects should migrate to Sqids where compatible.

name: facebook/graph-sdk
remediation_notes: Pin v5.7.0 and audit Guzzle for security updates; the SDK is stable for v2.10 Graph API features. Consider upgrading to maintained Facebook SDKs only if you need newer API versions.

name: knplabs/gaufrette
remediation_notes: Gaufrette was PHP's first filesystem abstraction layer but Flysystem took over the ecosystem. The code is stable and unlikely to have vulnerabilities, but without active maintenance, dependency updates will eventually break it. Migrate to Flysystem.

name: setasign/fpdf
remediation_notes: FPDF is explicitly frozen with no planned development; 1037 days since last update. Top dependent fpdi-fpdf (11M downloads) stabilizes usage. Migrate to TCPDF or mPDF for active maintenance and security updates.

name: php-http/multipart-stream-builder
remediation_notes: Small, stable PSR-7 utility (322 LOC) dormant for 600+ days; practical for dependents to vendor inline. No maintained alternatives for this niche.

name: beberlei/doctrineextensions
remediation_notes: Top dependents can fork and maintain versions with the specific database functions they need. The codebase is stable and doesn't require ongoing maintenance.

name: seld/signal-handler
remediation_notes: Author deprecated in favor of PHP's native pcntl_signal (7.4+). At 239 LOC this is inlineable if you need signal handler stacking, but most should migrate to PHP built-ins.

name: carbonphp/carbon-doctrine-types
remediation_notes: Copy the 163 lines of Doctrine type mappings into your project to drop the unmaintained dependency. Only two consumers make this practical.
